verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS customer data platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a Privacy Portal for regulatory compliance and Consent Management for end-user collection preferences. Neither states that customer data is excluded from AI model training or offers an opt-out from it. These are adjacent privacy controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
